dataset.name: Salesforce
dataset.does: Enterprise CRM platform (Sales Cloud) with the largest integration ecosystem in the category.
dataset.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 web-server + JWT-bearer flows; connected apps issue client id/secret.

dataset.breadth: Huge: REST + SOAP + Bulk v2 + Streaming + Platform Events + Metadata API

dataset.name: HubSpot

dataset.gate_detail: Free CRM tier is self-serve; create a private app token or register a public app instantly.
dataset.breadth: Very broad: CRM objects, marketing events, workflows, files, webhooks (~150+ endpoints)

dataset.name: Pipedrive
dataset.does: Sales CRM for SMBs with visual pipelines.
dataset.auth_detail: Per-user API token (simple) or OAuth2 for marketplace apps.
dataset.gate_detail: 14-day trial self-serve; API token visible in personal settings right away.
dataset.breadth: Broad CRUD: deals, persons, activities, notes, webhooks (~100 endpoints)

dataset.name: Attio
dataset.does: Real-time collaborative CRM with a highly customizable data model (objects, attributes, lists) for GTM teams.
dataset.auth_detail: API key (workspace token) or OAuth2; both sent as Authorization: Bearer, Basic also accepted; same scope model for both.

dataset.name: Podio

dataset.breadth: Broad legacy REST API (orgs, spaces, apps, items, tasks, files, contacts, webhooks) with official client libraries; API call-capacity upgrades are a paid add-on ($23/mo+).
dataset.blocker: Legacy API, 8-hour OAuth tokens, no first-party MCP
dataset.notes: No first-party MCP; only community/third-party servers. podio.com/pricing now 301-redirects to progress.com.

dataset.name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
dataset.does: B2C e-commerce platform; Commerce APIs (B2C Commerce API/SCAPI, OCAPI) for storefront/shopper and admin operations.
dataset.auth_detail: SLAS (Shopper Login and API Access Service) issues ShopperToken JWTs (30-min access + refresh) using OAuth 2.1 grants: authorization_code_pkce for registered/guest public clients, client_credentials for private guests, getTrustedSystemAccessToken for trusted systems; SLAS admin tools use Salesforce Account Manager.
dataset.gate_detail: Each SLAS tenant is tied to a licensed B2C Commerce instance; SLAS clients are created by admins with the SLAS Organization Administrator role in Account Manager + SLAS Admin UI; guest 'shopper' tokens are free per-request but still need a registered SLAS client; no self-serve path.
dataset.breadth: Moderate-to-broad - SCAPI shopper + admin APIs and legacy OCAPI, but auth spans Account Manager, SLAS public/private clients, and tenant setup.
dataset.blocker: No self-serve credentials: requires a licensed B2C Commerce instance and admin-provisioned SLAS clients (Account Manager + SLAS Org Admin role); live developer.salesforce.com docs also aggressively bot-block (HTTP 403).
dataset.notes: Official SLAS page fetched via Wayback (May 2026 snapshot, 200); live page returns 403 (Akamai). Confirms OAuth 2.1 grant table, guest/registered shopper tokens, Account Manager admin flow.

dataset.name: Magento (Adobe Commerce)
dataset.does: Open-source commerce platform (Adobe Commerce / Magento Open Source).
dataset.auth_detail: Integration access tokens (Bearer), OAuth2 for apps, session/key pairs for admin.
dataset.gate_detail: Free open-source edition self-hostable; admin creates an integration token (you are the admin).
dataset.breadth: Broad: catalog, inventory, orders, customers + GraphQL storefront APIs

dataset.name: Squarespace
dataset.does: Website builder with commerce; REST API covers core commerce objects.
dataset.auth_detail: Single API key (Bearer) per site.
dataset.gate_detail: API access requires a paid (Business+) site plan; key generated in site settings.
dataset.breadth: Narrow: products, inventory, orders, transactions, webhooks
dataset.blocker: Narrow API scope, paid plan required

dataset.name: Ecwid
dataset.does: Hosted e-commerce platform (online store/shopping cart) with a REST API covering store catalog, orders, customers, payments and shipping.
dataset.auth_detail: Every request needs a Bearer access token (query-param token passing disabled). Public apps obtain tokens via OAuth 2.0; private 'custom' apps skip OAuth and copy a static access token from the app dashboard; native iframe apps receive an encrypted payload with store ID + token.
dataset.gate_detail: Anyone creates an app free in the Ecwid dashboard and gets a token for their own store immediately. Distributing a 'public app' to other merchants requires Ecwid's app review.
dataset.breadth: Broad: products, orders, customers, categories, discounts/coupons, payment and shipping integration, checkout, webhooks, plus storefront JS APIs and site theming.
dataset.notes: api-docs.ecwid.com 302-redirects to docs.ecwid.com. Official docs confirmed token-based auth with OAuth 2.0 for public apps; community MCP wrapper documented by Truto.

dataset.name: Gumroad
dataset.does: Creator commerce platform for selling digital products, subscriptions and memberships, with a v2 REST API at api.gumroad.com.
dataset.auth_detail: REST-based OAuth API returning JSON: register an OAuth application and click 'Generate access token'; five scopes (view_profile, edit_products, view_sales, mark_sales_as_shipped, refund_sales). The license-verify endpoint requires no OAuth app.
dataset.gate_detail: Any Gumroad account can register an OAuth app or generate an access token from account settings; no approval step.
dataset.breadth: Moderate: products (variant categories, offer codes, custom fields), user, sales (ship/refund), subscribers, licenses, and resource_subscriptions webhooks (8 event types).
dataset.notes: Live gumroad.com/api is an Inertia.js page (HTTP 200 but JS shell); content confirmed via Wayback snapshot. Community MCP servers listed on mcpmarket.com and hexmos.com.

dataset.name: Amazon Selling Partner
dataset.does: Amazon's unified API for selling partners (orders, listings, finance, FBA).
dataset.auth_detail: Login-with-Amazon OAuth2 + AWS SigV4 (IAM role) for most endpoints.
dataset.gate_detail: Requires a Professional seller account ($39.99/mo, self-serve) then self-registered app (LWA credentials) - or vendor status for Vendor APIs.
dataset.breadth: Very broad: orders, inventory, pricing, FBA, finance, reports, notifications
dataset.blocker: Professional seller account + IAM/LWA wiring

dataset.gate_detail: No public credential path exists. Enterprise page says 'Embedded checkouts, multi-rail payouts, APIs and SDKs' - API access appears to be a contact-sales/partner arrangement.
dataset.breadth: None published: no endpoint reference, developer portal, or API docs found for fanbasis.com or commas.com.
dataset.blocker: no public API
dataset.notes: fanbasis.com 301-redirects to commas.com; rebrand confirmed on-page. Commas homepage (fetched, 200) advertises a beta MCP tool ('Run Commas from your AI assistant. Create checkout links, issue refunds and pull your numbers in plain English') and enterprise APIs, but /enterprises is marketing-only. No developer docs portal found.

dataset.breadth: Very broad: SERP API, Keywords, DataForSEO Labs, Backlinks, Domain Analytics, On-Page, Content Analysis

dataset.name: Ahrefs

dataset.name: MrScraper

dataset.breadth: Moderate: Scraper API (Scrape Markdown, Get Screenshot, Scrape JSON, Listing Page, Scrape Sitemap, Web Unblocker) and Platform API (Authentication, Scraper, Result, Analytic resources); scrapers can be exposed as API endpoints.
dataset.notes: Official docs list an MCP server for AI agents alongside Python, Node.js and LangChain SDKs and a CLI.

dataset.name: Apify
dataset.does: Web-scraping/automation platform (Actors) with storage, proxies, scheduling.
dataset.auth_detail: Personal access tokens (Bearer) with per-token permissions.
dataset.gate_detail: Free tier with platform credits; token in console instantly.
dataset.breadth: Very broad: actors run/input/dataset API, key-value store, schedules, webhooks, log

dataset.name: Firecrawl
dataset.does: Web-scraping API for LLMs (crawl, scrape, extract to markdown/structured).
dataset.auth_detail: Bearer API key.
dataset.gate_detail: Free tier with credits, self-serve dashboard, instant key.
dataset.breadth: Focused but deep: scrape, crawl, map, search, extract, v2 agents SDK

dataset.name: Bright Data
dataset.does: Web-data platform: proxies, Web Unlocker, SERP API, Web Scraper APIs and datasets for collecting public web data.
dataset.auth_detail: Scrapers/Datasets API uses 'Authorization: Bearer <API key>'; 'We create a default key for you upon account creation automatically' (shown once, configurable permissions/expiration). Note: proxy/zone endpoints (Web Unlocker/SERP) traditionally use Basic auth with customer-ID/zone credentials.
dataset.gate_detail: Sign up and a default API key is created automatically; more keys via Account settings. MCP free tier gives new accounts 5,000 free requests/month.
dataset.breadth: Very broad: proxy network APIs, Web Unlocker, SERP API, scraper/dataset APIs, plus SDKs and a CLI reusing the same API key.
dataset.notes: brightdata.com/mcp 301-redirects to docs.brightdata.com/ai/mcp-server/overview: vendor-built MCP server (powered by Web Unlocker), deployable managed-remote or self-hosted, source at github.com/brightdata/brightdata-mcp.

dataset.name: Sherlock
dataset.does: Open-source (MIT) Python CLI OSINT tool that hunts social-media accounts by username across 400+ social networks.
dataset.auth_detail: No authentication at all - it is a locally installed command-line tool (pipx/pip/uv install, Docker image, distro packages), not a hosted service.
dataset.gate_detail: Free open-source software; install from GitHub/PyPI and run 'sherlock <username>'. No credentials, keys or accounts involved.
dataset.breadth: N/A - CLI tool with JSON/CSV/XLSX file output and proxy options; no API endpoints or SaaS surface.
dataset.blocker: no public API
dataset.notes: It is a tool, not an API: the repo README (fetched) documents CLI usage only (400+ sites, ~92.6k stars). Community MCP exposure exists only as third-party wrappers, e.g. an Apify actor runnable through Apify's MCP server at mcp.apify.com.

dataset.name: Waterfall.io
dataset.does: B2B contact/company data API that aggregates 30+ data vendors behind one endpoint for contact/phone/company enrichment, prospecting, search and email verification.
dataset.auth_detail: 'All requests require an API key in the x-api-key header' (base URL api.waterfall.io). API Key Management supports master keys with sub-keys; some endpoints (Prospector, enrichments) are async.
dataset.gate_detail: No self-serve signup or trial. Main site offers only 'Book a Call' and an access-request form ('Thanks, we'll review your request shortly') - keys are issued after team review.
dataset.breadth: Broad for B2B data: Search Contact/Company, Prospector, Contact/Phone/Company Enrichment, Company Reveal (IP), Email Verification, Job Change Detection, Account Reporting; agent skills + llms.txt provided.
dataset.blocker: credentials are gated behind sales contact / access review (no self-serve)
dataset.notes: Official docs fetched: full REST reference with x-api-key auth. Docs point coding agents to 'Agent Skills' (a Waterfall API Skills GitHub repo) rather than an MCP server; MCP search hits refer to the enrichment technique or other vendors.

dataset.name: Clay
dataset.does: Data-intelligence/spreadsheet platform (enrichment, waterfalls, AI agents in Clay).
dataset.auth_detail: OAuth2 for public apps; per-user API keys for private API use.
dataset.gate_detail: Self-serve signup but paid plans; API access tied to plan credits.
dataset.breadth: Moderate: tables, rows, enrichment runs, webhooks (public API subset of product)
dataset.blocker: API subset of a heavy product; plan-gated usage

dataset.gate_detail: Free account; fine-grained PAT or GitHub App self-serve instantly.
dataset.breadth: Huge: repos, PRs, issues, actions, packages, orgs (~500+ REST endpoints + GraphQL)

dataset.name: Cloudflare

dataset.auth_detail: Scoped API tokens (Bearer); user tokens; mTLS options; OAuth2 for some flows.
dataset.gate_detail: Free plan self-serve; scoped tokens created instantly in dash.
dataset.breadth: Huge: zones, DNS, workers, KV, R2, WAF, rulesets (~1000+ endpoints)

dataset.name: Supabase
dataset.does: Open-source Firebase alternative: Postgres, auth, storage, edge functions.
dataset.auth_detail: Anon + service_role JWT keys for data APIs; PAT/OAuth2 for management API.
dataset.gate_detail: Free projects self-serve instantly; keys in dashboard; management API PAT self-serve.
dataset.breadth: Auto REST (PostgREST) per project + Storage/Auth admin + management API (projects, branches)

dataset.name: Neo4j
dataset.does: Graph database; Cypher can be executed over a documented HTTP Query API against self-hosted Neo4j or AuraDB instances.
dataset.auth_detail: Basic auth (RFC 7617, username:password base64) is the standard scheme; Bearer tokens via SSO/OIDC providers also supported; AuraDB HTTP API uses the same Basic/Bearer patterns.
dataset.gate_detail: Query API enabled by default on Neo4j servers (self-hosted Community/Enterprise free download) or AuraDB instances; AuraDB offers a free-tier instance so a developer gets credentials in minutes without contacting sales.
dataset.breadth: Broad - the HTTP Query API accepts arbitrary Cypher, so effectively the whole database is reachable; drivers (Bolt) exist for all major languages.
dataset.notes: Fetched all three official pages live. Query API supports HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2, executes Cypher; auth page shows Basic and Bearer headers.

dataset.name: Snowflake
dataset.does: Cloud data warehouse; SQL API lets you submit SQL statements over REST and poll for results.
dataset.auth_detail: Key-pair JWT (RS256, RSA key fingerprint in subject, max 1h validity) or OAuth Bearer tokens (authorization code / client credentials); programmatic access tokens (PAT) also listed.
dataset.gate_detail: Requires a Snowflake account (30-day free trial is self-serve); a user/role with the right grants must be set up in the account; key-pair requires generating an RSA keypair and assigning the public key to the user.
dataset.breadth: Broad for data - any SQL can run via the API (async submission, results, cancellations); not a full admin/config API surface.
dataset.notes: Auth page fetched live confirms key-pair JWT + OAuth (+PROGRAMMATIC_ACCESS_TOKEN). Snowflake-managed MCP Server GA in Cortex Agents docs; Snowflake-Labs/mcp repo deprecated pointing to it.

dataset.name: MongoDB Atlas
dataset.does: Managed MongoDB cloud; Atlas Administration API (REST) manages projects, clusters, users, and (via MCP/drivers) data.
dataset.auth_detail: Org/project API keys using HTTP Digest auth with IP access-list requirement; newer alternative is service accounts (OAuth2 client-credentials bearer tokens); both documented on configure-api-access.
dataset.gate_detail: Atlas account self-serve with permanently free M0 tier; API keys/service accounts are created by an org or project admin in the Atlas UI/CLI (invited member model, IP allowlist must be set).
dataset.breadth: Broad - full Atlas Administration API reference (clusters, network access, users, backups, billing) plus data plane via standard MongoDB drivers.
dataset.notes: Admin auth page fetched live: API keys (digest) + IP access list + service accounts. Official MongoDB MCP server (mongodb-js/mongodb-mcp-server) covers read/write data + Atlas tools.

dataset.does: Cloud observability platform (metrics, logs, traces, monitors).
dataset.auth_detail: API key + application key pair (DD-API-Key header + app key).
dataset.gate_detail: Trial self-serve; create both keys in org settings instantly.
dataset.breadth: Very broad: metrics, events, monitors, dashboards, logs, incidents, usage

dataset.auth_detail: User auth tokens (Bearer) or OAuth2 integrations.
dataset.gate_detail: Free developer tier self-serve; create auth token instantly.

dataset.gate_detail: Needs a Smartsheet account; access tokens self-generated from the user's account, OAuth apps self-registered; meaningful API use generally requires a paid plan or trial, and org admins can restrict API token management.

dataset.gate_detail: Fully self-serve: OAuth2 apps created from the developer settings page, PATs generated from ID settings page for any Harvest account (free trial available).

dataset.notes: Auth page and MCP help article both fetched live; MCP article describes connecting Harvest data via MCP for Pro/Premium plans.

dataset.gate_detail: Account + test-mode keys instantly self-serve; live keys activate with business details (self-serve).
dataset.breadth: Huge: payments, billing, connect, issuing, terminal, treasury (~100s endpoints)

dataset.auth_detail: API key from dashboard, e.g. paygent_sdk.init(api_key='your-paygent-api-key'); no OAuth anywhere in docs; payments collected via Stripe payment links, not NMI.

dataset.name: iPayX

dataset.auth_detail: Bearer token on POST https://api.ipayx.ai/functions/v1/fx-audit-engine (per official llms.txt: 'Auth: Bearer token').
dataset.gate_detail: Official pricing: 'Forensic Pack from $297, API plans from $99/mo' - buy plan, get API token.
dataset.breadth: Narrow/niche: one core fx-audit-engine endpoint plus audit tools (spread calc, FX scoring, forensic report, hash verification); OpenAPI 3.1 published at /.well-known/openapi.json.
dataset.notes: Site is a React SPA; official llms.txt (linked from the site's ai-content meta tag) provided the full API/MCP picture. MCP endpoint mcp.ipayx.ai/mcp (Streamable HTTP).

dataset.name: QuickBooks
dataset.does: SMB accounting SaaS (QuickBooks Online); Accounting API provides CRUD on ~29 entity types plus reports.
dataset.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow with refresh tokens (no per-user API keys); app registered on Intuit Developer portal, connect to a company (realm ID) via browser consent; 100-day refresh-token window.
dataset.gate_detail: Free Intuit developer account is self-serve; creating an app and connecting to a sandbox company is easy (localhost redirect URIs accepted in sandbox); production go-live requires a public HTTPS callback and Intuit's production activation process.
dataset.breadth: Broad for accounting - entities, queries, batch operations, attachments, reports; Sandbox environment auto-provisioned per developer app.
dataset.blocker: Full OAuth app setup + browser handshake required (no simple API key); production apps go through Intuit activation, and refresh tokens lapse after ~100 days.
dataset.notes: Intuit portal is a JS SPA (fetched shell 200); official MCP README fetched and confirms OAuth2, sandbox-easy vs production-harder gating. Official Intuit-org MCP server with 145 tools.

dataset.name: Xero
dataset.does: Accounting platform for SMBs (invoices, bank feeds, ledger).
dataset.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 with xero-tenant-id header per org.
dataset.gate_detail: Free trial org + self-serve app registration (30-min setup); partner apps free with connected orgs.
dataset.breadth: Broad: accounting, bank feeds, assets, payroll (AU/NZ/UK), files, webhooks

dataset.name: Brex

dataset.auth_detail: Bearer user/API tokens (admin-provisioned from Brex Dashboard > Developer) as Authorization header; OAuth2 for third-party apps and the Brex MCP server (OAuth authorization server accounts-api.brex.com/oauth2/default, supports Dynamic Client Registration).

dataset.notes: Both pages fetched live. Hosted Brex MCP server at api.brex.com/mcp; OAuth or API-key auth documented.

dataset.does: Spend/finance automation platform; Developer API for cards, bills, accounting sync, transactions, users, plus webhooks and Custom Records.
dataset.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0: client-credentials grant (internal server-to-server) or authorization-code + refresh (third-party); token endpoint /developer/v1/token authenticated with HTTP Basic (client_id:client_secret); scope model resource:read/write.

dataset.notes: Ramp ships llms.txt machine-readable docs (fetched live). Official Developer MCP server + account-data MCP (support.ramp.com Ramp MCP guide). Ramp also pushes an AI-agent story: CLI agent mode, Agent Cards.

dataset.name: PitchBook
dataset.does: Private-markets research data API (Direct Data): on-demand REST access to companies, deals, investors, funds, people, LPs and service providers.
dataset.auth_detail: Official help: 'Our team will work with you ... establish the API connection through an API key or authentication token'; base URL https://api.pitchbook.com; third-party docs show an 'Authorization: PB-Token <key>' header.
dataset.gate_detail: 'To start your API connection, you will need to send a request directly to our Direct Data team' (or via Plugins & Apps section of the PitchBook platform for existing clients). No self-serve, no trial for the API itself.
dataset.breadth: Broad data coverage (many relational endpoints incl. financing details, deal stock info, VC exit predictor), but access-gated; official endpoint docs shared privately (a published Postman collection exists).
dataset.blocker: No self-serve credentials: API access requires going through PitchBook's Direct Data sales/enterprise process; no MCP and no public sandbox.
dataset.notes: Official help page fetched live (pitchbook.com blocks some bots; curl with browser UA worked). Auth header format (PB-Token) from dltHub/Frontegg third-party docs since PitchBook's own endpoint docs sit behind the sales process.

dataset.name: NotebookLM
dataset.does: Enterprise notebook API (Gemini Notebook Enterprise, formerly NotebookLM Enterprise) on Google Cloud: create/manage notebooks, sources, sharing and audio-overview generation via Discovery Engine endpoints.
dataset.auth_detail: All examples use 'Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth print-access-token)' - Google-issued OAuth2 bearer tokens; no API-key option.
dataset.gate_detail: Requires Gemini Notebook Enterprise admin setup and licenses; sharing needs the Cloud NotebookLM User IAM role. Not available to consumer NotebookLM users.
dataset.breadth: Limited: v1alpha (pre-GA) REST on {location}-discoveryengine.googleapis.com covering notebooks.create/get/listRecentlyViewed/batchDelete/share plus source and audio-overview pages; no GraphQL.
dataset.blocker: Enterprise-only: needs Gemini Enterprise licensing + admin provisioning, and the API is v1alpha pre-GA with a narrow operation set.
dataset.notes: Fetched official Google Cloud docs live. Product rebranded under Gemini Enterprise ('Gemini Notebook Enterprise'); API is served through Discovery Engine, not a standalone NotebookLM API.

dataset.name: Otter AI
dataset.does: AI meeting notetaker whose official Otter MCP Server exposes meeting transcripts, cross-meeting search and insights to Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity and other AI clients.
dataset.auth_detail: Official help article: 'All access is OAuth-authenticated with granular permissions. Your AI assistant can only access meetings you explicitly authorize'; connect via Claude/ChatGPT connector directories.
dataset.gate_detail: Any Otter account can connect from the Claude/ChatGPT connector directories; workspace admins can pre-provision the connector for orgs. Plan restrictions for MCP are not stated.
dataset.breadth: MCP-only agent surface (search transcripts, analyze patterns, generate content from meeting data); no documented public REST API.
dataset.notes: Fetched the official Zendesk help article live (via Zendesk Help Center API). Vendor-hosted MCP, no local install. MCP setup covers Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Perplexity.

dataset.name: Fathom
dataset.does: AI meeting recorder with a REST API for meetings/transcripts/recording artifacts (plus webhooks, TS/Python SDKs, OAuth for public apps) and official MCP connectors for Claude and ChatGPT.
dataset.auth_detail: 'X-Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY' header against https://api.fathom.ai/external/v1; keys generated in User Settings > API Access and scoped to the creator's meetings; separate OAuth flow for public integrations.
dataset.gate_detail: 'Head to the API Access section of your User Settings and generate an API key' - self-serve from any account; keys can only access your own/shared meetings.
dataset.breadth: Broad for its domain: list/search meetings, fetch transcripts, recording artifacts, webhooks, SDKs (TypeScript/Python), OAuth apps.
dataset.notes: Developer portal (developers.fathom.ai) fetched live. Docs are Mintlify-hosted with llms.txt; MCP docs section is first-class alongside REST and OAuth docs.

dataset.name: Consensus
dataset.does: Academic search API over 400M+ peer-reviewed papers: query returns ranked papers with titles, authors, journals, citation counts, DOIs and optional full-text excerpts.
dataset.auth_detail: 'Pass the key in the x-api-key header. Requests without a valid key return 401.' Keys created in Consensus under profile > 'API & MCP Dashboard' > Keys and clients. (Brief hint said OAuth, but current official docs use API keys.)
dataset.gate_detail: 'The API is self-serve on every Consensus plan' - Free includes 30 calls/mo, Pro 500, Teams 2,000, Enterprise custom; rate limit 1 req/s on lower tiers.
dataset.breadth: Narrow but deep: one main REST endpoint (GET https://api.consensus.app/v1/search) with pagination/full-text options plus a legacy variant.
dataset.notes: Fetched official docs live. MCP is explicitly bundled with the API dashboard (mcp.consensus.app/mcp; Claude/ChatGPT/Cursor/VS Code setup guides).

dataset.name: Reducto
dataset.does: Document-parsing API: converts PDFs, images, spreadsheets, slides and forms (30+ file types) into structured, LLM-ready JSON with parse/classify/extract/split/edit endpoints and pipelines.
dataset.auth_detail: Bearer token: '-H "Authorization: Bearer $REDUCTO_API_KEY"'; key created in Reducto Studio (sidebar > API Keys > Create API Key).
dataset.gate_detail: 'Go to studio.reducto.ai and sign up for a free account', then create an API key in the Studio sidebar - free signup, paid usage tiers.
dataset.breadth: Broad document-AI surface: Parse, Classify, Extract, Split, Edit, Pipelines; SDKs in Python/Node.js/Go + REST + a Reducto CLI for local files.
dataset.notes: Official Mintlify docs fetched live as markdown. Quickstart is explicitly agent-first ('Fastest path for coding agents': CLI, MCP, or SDK). Hosted MCP at mcp.reducto.ai/mcp.

dataset.name: Devin
dataset.does: Autonomous AI software engineer (Cognition) with a documented REST API and an official Devin MCP server (mcp.devin.ai) letting external AI tools create/manage Devin sessions, playbooks, knowledge and schedules.
dataset.auth_detail: Devin API key from account settings; token types are cog_-prefixed org-scoped/enterprise service-user keys; 'The MCP server supports the same authentication methods as the Devin API.'
dataset.gate_detail: 'Sign up for a Devin account at Devin.ai' and 'Generate an API key from your account settings' - self-serve signup, but Devin is a paid/usage-based (ACU) product; API access included with the account.
dataset.breadth: Broad: large api-reference section (302 API pages in llms index, v2/v3 endpoints incl. sessions, knowledge, service-user API keys) plus MCP and DeepWiki MCP.
dataset.notes: Official docs fetched live as markdown. MCP server is authenticated and first-party; covers session management, playbooks, knowledge, scheduling.

dataset.name: higgsfield
dataset.does: Generative-media API platform (Soul image gen, Genjutsu motion transfer, Kling, Seedance, etc.): submit a request to a model endpoint, then poll or receive a webhook for results.
dataset.auth_detail: Key ID + secret pair: 'Authorization: Key YOUR_KEY_ID:YOUR_KEY_SECRET' (legacy hf-api-key/hf-secret headers also accepted); credentials created in Higgsfield Console (console.higgsfield.ai); server-side only.
dataset.gate_detail: Self-serve API platform at open.higgsfield.ai (dashboard with API keys, playground, billing, per-second usage pricing e.g. 'from $0.144/s'); free trial not confirmed in docs.
dataset.breadth: Model catalog of image/video endpoints with shared auth/polling/webhook/upload docs; official Python + TypeScript SDKs; no CLI found in official docs despite the brief hint (higgsfield.ai/cli).
dataset.notes: Official docs and open platform fetched live. No MCP server mentioned in official docs (community wrappers may exist). Asynchronous job pattern (request_id/status_url/cancel_url/webhooks).

dataset.name: Mermaid CLI
dataset.does: Local open-source CLI (mmdc, @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli) that renders Mermaid diagram definitions to SVG/PNG/PDF via bundled Chromium/Puppeteer; also exposes a Node run() function.
dataset.auth_detail: Fully local npm-installable tool (npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli, Docker image minlag/mermaid-cli); no accounts, keys or network service involved.
dataset.gate_detail: Nothing to gate: MIT-licensed tool installed from npm/Docker. Note: local tool, not an API.
dataset.breadth: Local tool, not an API - renders single .mmd files or Markdown code blocks; a Node API exists but is explicitly not covered by semver.
dataset.blocker: no public API
dataset.notes: GitHub README fetched live. It is a local rendering tool (useful to ship inside an integration's runtime, e.g. pre-rendering diagrams), but there is no hosted API to authenticate against or integrate with.

dataset.name: YouTube Transcript
dataset.does: Hosted YouTube data API (transcriptapi.com): transcripts (with/without timestamps), YouTube search, channel search, playlists and metadata via REST, billed per-credit, with an official YouTube MCP and agent skills.
dataset.auth_detail: 'Authorization: Bearer API_KEY' header on https://transcriptapi.com/api/v2/youtube/* endpoints.
dataset.gate_detail: 'Get Started Free' signup with credit-based pricing (e.g. 1 credit per transcript/search); signup/login pages live; production users cited at ~11M transcripts/mo.
dataset.breadth: YouTube-only: transcript, search, channel search, channel/video endpoints; every feature 'works via API, MCP, and agent skills'. No GraphQL, no multi-platform.
dataset.notes: Site is a React SPA with prerendering; fetched the prerendered homepage (Googlebot UA) which contains the full API reference with curl examples, auth header, credit costs and MCP/agent-skill docs.

dataset.name: Grain
dataset.does: AI meeting recorder/conversation-intelligence platform with a public REST API v2 (recordings, transcripts, highlights, uploads, webhooks) and an official Grain MCP server for AI clients.
dataset.auth_detail: 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' plus required 'Public-Api-Version' header; three token types: Personal Access Token, Workspace Access Token, and OAuth2 Authorization Code (with PKCE) tokens.
dataset.gate_detail: PATs/WATs 'Generated manually from the integrations page' (grain.com/app/settings/integrations?tab=api) - self-serve; note 'The workspace scope is not available on all plans' (Workspace API is on the Business plan).
dataset.breadth: Broad for its domain: full endpoint reference (recordings, highlights, uploads, webhooks), versioned API (2025-10-31 / 2026-10-01), rate-limit docs, official MCP docs.
dataset.notes: Developer hub at developers.grain.com fetched live (docs.grain.com and grain.com/developers do not exist). OAuth2 flow fully documented alongside PAT/WAT tokens.
